import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    
    a = list(map(int, data[1:1+n]))
    
    mid = (n - 1) // 2
    
    # Find the mid-th smallest element (0-indexed)
    a_sorted = sorted(a)
    print(a_sorted[mid])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
